links.effect: RAG models 90-94% consensus alignment vs 68-82% baseline; high-risk recommendations 0% in RAG vs 6-14% baseline (P<0.001).
links.quote: Most importantly, RAG models completely eliminated the possibility of a High-Risk recommendation (0%, 95% CI: 0.0% − 2.4% per-response) across the 150 total outputs evaluated for all RAG configurations.

links.outcome: Baseline LLM alignment with clinical consensus and missing clinically significant content
links.effect: Baseline models opposed consensus up to 20% (Grok Base); missing content of great clinical significance 14-22% for baselines vs 2-4% for RAG.
links.quote: Furthermore, RAG significantly reduced the incidence of Missing Content of great clinical significance, with all RAG models scoring 2–4% in this category, compared to 14–22% for baseline models.
